svg.title: Terminal showing PostgreSQL ERROR deadlock detected with its DETAIL, HINT and CONTEXT lines
svg.desc: A psql session in which two concurrent transactions updated the same two rows in opposite order. The second session receives ERROR: deadlock detected, with a DETAIL block naming both waiting processes and the transactions they wait on, a HINT to see the server log for query details, a CONTEXT line reading while updating tuple (0,1) in relation accounts, and finally ROLLBACK. Below it, the server log shows the same entry with the two conflicting UPDATE statements included.

text.tspan: UPDATE accounts SET balance = balance + 10 WHERE id = 1;

svg.text: DETAIL: Process 117 waits for ShareLock on transaction 734; blocked by process 116.
Process 116 waits for ShareLock on transaction 733; blocked by process 117.
HINT: See server log for query details.
CONTEXT: while updating tuple (0,1) in relation "accounts"
# and the server log the HINT points at — with the actual statements:
Process 117: UPDATE accounts SET balance = balance + 10 WHERE id = 1;
Process 116: UPDATE accounts SET balance = balance + 10 WHERE id = 2;
↑ Only the SERVER LOG names the two statements — the client never sees them.
